name: github_get_file_contents
description: Read a file (or list a directory) from a repository, including PRIVATE repos. Returns the file's metadata plus base64-encoded `content` (decode it to read the text) and the file's `sha` — capture that sha if you intend to update the file with github_create_or_update_file. Provide `owner`, `repo`, `path` (e.g. 'src/main.rs'); optional `ref` is a branch, tag, or commit SHA (defaults to the repo's default branch).

path.description: Path to the file or directory within the repo.

ref.description: Optional branch, tag, or commit SHA. Defaults to the default branch.
